Defender Pass ============= From Dungeon Defenders 2 Wiki Jump to: [navigation](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defender_Pass#mw-head) , [search](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defender_Pass#p-search) [![](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/9/97/Defender_Pass_UI_Example.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Defender_Pass_UI_Example.png) [](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Defender_Pass_UI_Example.png "Enlarge") **Defender Pass UI** The **Defender Pass** is a tiered progression system, similar to a battle pass. Players unlock in-game content by completing [daily and weekly missions](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Missions "Missions") , and gaining experience by playing [maps](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Maps "Maps") . These tiers offer rewards like [Gold](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gold "Gold") , [Gems](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems "Gems") , [Materials](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Crafting_Materials "Crafting Materials") , [Shards](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards "Shards") , [Flairs](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Flairs "Flairs") , [Costumes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Costumes "Costumes") , and more. While most tiers provide premium rewards, there are also free rewards available. At the end of a **Defender Pass** season, a bundle containing all its skins will be available for purchase at a higher cost than the **Defender Pass**. Currently, the price is [![Gem Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/8d/Gem_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems) 2,080. In the **Defender Pass** UI, a timer for the next season can be found in the top left corner. However, this timer is not permanent and can be adjusted by Chromatic Games as needed to accommodate any changes in the schedule. Purchasable Tiers ----------------- * **Standard Pass ([![Gem Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/8d/Gem_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems) 1,500)**: Unlocks the **Defender Pass** for the current season with access to all its premium rewards. * **Bonus Pass ([![Gem Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/8d/Gem_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems) 1,840)**: Includes all benefits of the Standard Pass, plus an additional 20 levels at a discounted price. While the **Defender Pass** costs a minimum of [![Gem Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/8d/Gem_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems) 1,500, players can earn this amount back throughout the pass. Notably, [![Gem Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/8d/Gem_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems) 150 are awarded for free at Tier 73.
